==========================================
__has_include with angle brackets
==========================================

#if __has_include(<endian.h>)
int a;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (system_lib_string)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_include with quotes
==========================================

#if __has_include("missing.h") || __has_cpp_attribute(nodiscard) >= 201603
int c;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (binary_expression
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (string_literal
            (string_content))))
      (binary_expression
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (identifier)))
        (number_literal)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_attribute with an identifier
==========================================

#if __has_attribute(noreturn)
int b;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (identifier)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_cpp_attribute with a scoped name
==========================================

#if __has_cpp_attribute(clang::fallthrough)
int d;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (qualified_identifier
          (namespace_identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_embed and __has_warning with strings
==========================================

#if __has_embed("data.bin")
int e;
#endif
#if __has_warning("-Wdeprecated")
int f;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier)))
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_include combined with defined
==========================================

#if defined(__has_include) && __has_include(<a.h>)
int g;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (binary_expression
      (preproc_defined
        (identifier))
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (system_lib_string))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
extern "C" linkage inside preproc guards
==========================================

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

int a;

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (guarded_linkage
    (identifier)
    (string_literal
      (string_content))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))
    (identifier)))

==========================================
preproc block splitting parameter list
==========================================

void f(struct sockaddr *sap, int salen
#ifdef X
,
int q, unsigned short s
#endif
, int c) {}
void g(int a
#ifdef Y
, int b
#endif
) {}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (struct_specifier
            (type_identifier))
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (parameter_declaration
            (primitive_type)
            (identifier))
          (parameter_declaration
            (sized_type_specifier)
            (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (parameter_declaration
            (primitive_type)
            (identifier)))))
    (compound_statement)))

================================================================================
preproc block splitting argument list: f(a #ifdef ,b,c #endif)
================================================================================

void caller() {
  f(a
#ifdef COND
    ,b,c
#endif
    );
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (binary_expression
              (identifier)
              (preproc_ifdef
                (identifier)
                (identifier)
                (identifier)))))))))

================================================================================
preproc block splitting argument list between separators
================================================================================

void caller() {
  f(a,
#ifdef COND
    b,
#endif
    c);
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (identifier)
            (preproc_ifdef
              (identifier)
              (identifier))
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
infix continuation: f(a | b #ifdef | c #endif)
================================================================================

void caller() {
  f(a | b
#ifdef COND
    | c
#endif
    );
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (binary_expression
              (binary_expression
                (identifier)
                (identifier))
              (preproc_ifdef
                (identifier)
                (identifier)))))))))

================================================================================
infix continuation in designated initializer
================================================================================

struct hints { int flags; };
void caller() {
  struct hints h{
    .flags = A
#ifdef COND
             | B
#endif
    ,
  };
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (declaration
        (struct_specifier
          (type_identifier))
        (init_declarator
          (identifier)
          (initializer_list
            (initializer_pair
              (field_designator
                (field_identifier))
              (identifier))
            (preproc_ifdef
              (identifier)
              (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
concatenated string with macro: "lit" MACRO and MACRO "lit"
================================================================================

const char *s1 = "x" MACRO;
const char *s2 = MACRO "x";
const char *s3 = "a" "b" MACRO "c";

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (pointer_declarator
        (identifier))
      (concatenated_string
        (string_literal
          (string_content))
        (identifier))))
  (declaration
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (pointer_declarator
        (identifier))
      (concatenated_string
        (identifier)
        (string_literal
          (string_content)))))
  (declaration
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (pointer_declarator
        (identifier))
      (concatenated_string
        (string_literal
          (string_content))
        (string_literal
          (string_content))
        (identifier)
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))))
